cases.task: Explain how recursive execution composes with the durable TaskGraph.

direct.text: RLM helps the TaskGraph explore alternatives.

rlm.text: RLM is node-local inside one sealed plan. The TaskGraph remains the single scheduler, and recursive children create no second graph.

cases.task: Diagnose why two independent workers are unnecessarily serialized.

direct.text: Raise maxParallel so both workers can run.

rlm.text: Check hierarchical scope overlap on every write and any exclusive effect. Disjoint scopes can run in parallel without merely raising maxParallel.

cases.task: Choose models for planning, execution, and verification under subscription quotas.

direct.text: Use the strongest model for all steps.

rlm.text: Use high-tier models for planning and verification, low-tier models for bounded execution, and subscription-first routing before metered API. Preserve the Claude reserve and block it when unknown quota prevents proof.
